[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["crates/hanihi-core", "crates/hanihi-cli", "crates/hanihi-eval", "crates/mcp-echo-server"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/worikgh/hanihi"
readme = "README.md"

[workspace.dependencies]
ignore = "0.4"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "process", "io-util", "sync", "time", "signal"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
